g.text: A single-user room like this is about as small as it gets while every clearance still fits.
Clearances may overlap: the turning circle can run under the lavatory where the knee clearance allows it.
Dimensions follow the 2010 ADA Standards. The room and the fixtures are fictional.
Water closet centerline 16-18 in from the side wall (604.2)
Clear floor space 60 in x 56 in, any approach (604.3.1)
Grab bars 33-36 in above the floor (609.4)
Lavatory rim 34 in max, knee 27 in (606.3)
Clear floor at the lavatory 30 in x 48 in (305.3)
Door: 36 in x 48 in maneuvering space outside (404.2.4)
and it may not swing into any fixture clearance
